name: Line-of-sight geometry and output-record verification
purpose: Verify ray geometry, column accumulation, moment normalization, and record layout without observational scoring.
production_capability: Exosphere column-integral and Moon limb/anti-solar samplers.
configuration: Current Na spherical configuration; SPICE-dependent geometry must be supplied explicitly.
independent_reference: Closed-form sphere chords and direct first-moment division.
units: position m; number density m^-3; column density m^-2; speed m s^-1; brightness Rayleigh where applicable
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred LSO for current production operator; fixed epoch required when SPICE is enabled.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: No particles; deterministic mesh fields and rays.
procedure: Call the production ray marcher and integrand through a thin linked adapter for tangent, radial, miss, and shadowed rays; verify serialized variable order.
acceptance_criteria: All ray distances and constant-density columns within 1e-12 relative; shell quadrature within declared discretization error; exact field order.
expected_pass_result: Production LOS operator reproduces analytical paths and output schema.
status_semantics: PASS only after the callable production ray path is evaluated; source inspection is not PASS.
skip_reason: No standalone adapter currently reaches the production mesh ray marcher and sampler record writer.
missing_capability: Non-invasive deterministic field/ray fixture for PIC::ColumnIntegration.
